description: Pins the 6-axis test-relevance rubric, the would-fail-before recipe, the verdict gate, and the reviewer-spawns-issues pattern.

tests.input: Reviewing PR #42. The only new test asserts mock_send_email.assert_called_once() and nothing else.
Review PR #51. Walk me through how you confirm the new test would have failed before this PR.
PR #77 has no Closes or Refs line in its body. Tests are fine. What's the verdict?
I noticed three unrelated bugs while reviewing PR #88. None block merge.
PR #100: one new endpoint, one new test asserting response JSON, would-fail-before YES, Closes #99, no secrets.
